_comment: herdr-mcp remote task lifecycle (SPEC: form 20261001T230637-8744). The Worker only PRE-validates against a cached copy of this file (pushed every sync as snapshot.task_config); this copy, read directly by remote-mcp/tasks.py on the Mac, is the one that is actually enforced when a command is executed. Edit here, commit, push -- the next publisher tick picks it up with no redeploy.

research._secrets_comment: lib/agent-profiles.sh secrets_default_for_job withholds credentials for any job class matching *research* (it reads material we did not write). Terrene's authority for this feature explicitly grants the read-only vault identity (creds=readonly_vault) to a research task, so tasks.py passes spawn-task.sh an explicit --secrets to lift that default -- never a change to the shared job-class table, which stays withhold-by-default for every OTHER research-class spawn.
research.manifest_comment: KB/tl;dv are reached through their own MCP tools, not raw curl, so net_read (lib/task-manifest.sh's GET-approval scope) has nothing to name here.

caps._comment: Hard ceiling, not yet adjustable from an admin route (SPEC: 'adjustable later via a signed admin route like /admin/limits' -- deliberately deferred). Enforced on the Mac (remote-mcp/tasks.py) and pre-checked on the Worker (remote-mcp/worker/src/policy.ts TASK_CAPS) from this same file's pushed copy.
